citations.title: 2 months' notice before suing the Government or a public officer
citations.plain: Before suing the Central or a State Government, or a public officer over an act done in official capacity, you must give written notice and wait 2 months. If you need urgent relief, the court can let you sue without notice, but it must hear the Government before granting any relief.

citations.title: Limitation period for filing complaint
citations.plain: You must file a consumer complaint within two years from the date the problem (cause of action) arose. A later complaint can still be accepted if you show sufficient cause for the delay, but the Commission must record its reasons for condoning the delay.
